slot.brief: Ask which pollutant(s) cause ozone depletion and which cause acid rain / photochemical smog (identify by chemical reaction).

stem:
Match each atmospheric reaction with the environmental effect it is associated with, respectively:

(I) $\text{CF}_2\text{Cl}_2(g) \xrightarrow{h\nu} \text{CF}_2\text{Cl}\cdot(g) + \text{Cl}\cdot(g)$

(II) $\text{SO}_3(g) + \text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4(aq)$

(III) $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}_3\cdot(g) + \text{NO}_2(g) \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CO}_3\text{NO}_2(g)$
options: Ozone depletion, acid rain, and photochemical smog
Acid rain, ozone depletion, and photochemical smog
Ozone depletion, photochemical smog, and acid rain
Photochemical smog, acid rain, and ozone depletion

verdicts.working: (I) releases Cl·, causing ozone depletion; (II) forms H₂SO₄, associated with acid rain; (III) forms PAN, associated with photochemical smog.

working:
(I) UV photolysis of a chlorofluorocarbon releases a chlorine radical, which catalyses stratospheric ozone depletion.
(II) $\text{SO}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$: sulfuric acid contributes to acid rain.
(III) $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}_3\cdot + \text{NO}_2 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CO}_3\text{NO}_2$: formation of PAN is associated with photochemical smog.

Independent check: (I) releases Cl·, causing ozone depletion; (II) forms H₂SO₄, associated with acid rain; (III) forms PAN, associated with photochemical smog.
